content:
[Intro]
[D5]

[Verse 1]
[D5]I kept up with the pro-
phecy you spoke.
I kept up with the mes-
sage inside.
Lost sight of the i-
rony of twisted faith.
Lost sight of my soul
and it's void.

[Chorus]
[F5]Think I,
[E5]think I'm un-
[D#5]forgiven to
[D5]this world.
[F5]Think I,
[E5]think I'm un-
[D#5]forgiven to
[D5]this world.
Yeah.

[Verse 2]
[D5]Took a chance at decei-
ving myself. To
share in the con-
sequence of lies.
Childish with my reaso-
ning and pride.
Godless to the extent
that I died.

[Chorus]
[F5]Think I,
[E5]think I'm un-
[D#5]forgiven to
[D5]this world.
[F5]Think I,
[E5]think I'm un-
[D#5]forgiven to
[D5]this world.
[F5]Think I'm,
[E5]unforgi-
[D#5]ven.
[D5]

[Interlude]
[D5]

[Break]
[D5]

[Bridge]
[D5]No more raping in-
nocence.
No more raping in-
nocence.
No more raping in-
nocence.
No more raping inno-
cence. Step
inside the light
and see the fear
of God burn inside of me.
The gold was put to
flame to kill to burn
to mold it's pu-
rity.

[Outro]
[F5]Think I,
[E5]think I'm un-
[D#5]forgiven to
[D5]this world.
[F5]Think I,
[E5]think I'm un-
[D#5]forgiven to
[D5]this world.
[F5]Think I'm,
[E5]unforgi-
[D#5]ven.
[D5]
title: Unforgiven
tuning: D A D G B E
